solution: By de Moivre, $(\\cos\\theta+i\\sin\\theta)^{5}=\\cos 5\\theta+i\\sin 5\\theta$. The real part is $\\cos^{5}\\theta-10\\cos^{3}\\theta\\sin^{2}\\theta+5\\cos\\theta\\sin^{4}\\theta$. Replacing $\\sin^{2}\\theta=1-\\cos^{2}\\theta$: $\\cos^{5}\\theta-10\\cos^{3}\\theta(1-\\cos^{2}\\theta)+5\\cos\\theta(1-\\cos^{2}\\theta)^{2}=\\cos^{5}\\theta-10\\cos^{3}\\theta+10\\cos^{5}\\theta+5\\cos\\theta(1-2\\cos^{2}\\theta+\\cos^{4}\\theta)=16\\cos^{5}\\theta-20\\cos^{3}\\theta+5\\cos\\theta$.
hints: Take the real part and replace $\\sin^{2}\\theta$.
